put.summary: Change report status and process bans
put.description: Allows a manager to accept or reject an existing guest report. If the report is accepted (`isAccepted: true`), the system automatically issues a ban for the reported guest until the specified `expiresAt` date and sends an email notification. Requires MANAGER role.

401.description: Unauthorized - Valid JWT token is required
